name: Hoax
source:
Your hands are chained and your best friend holds the leash. You share the same spot at the back of the cart; too many people are being shipped in one night. It's freezing, but he needs you to be alive if he wants to get any money for your head. Maybe that's why he's trying to melt your heart, yet…

You must kiss him goodbye.

[From [url=https://a-villarroel.itch.io/hoax]Itch.io[/url]]
